patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Adapt.io only if your buying job matches “Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Cust” rather than Kaspr's shape. Choose Kaspr only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo ann” rather than Adapt.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Adapt.io leans contact-management; Kaspr leans lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Adapt.io is Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Custom contact sales; 7-day trial.; Kaspr is LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo annual headline..
- Company-size focus: Adapt.io (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Kaspr (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Adapt.io-leaning contact-management vs Kaspr-leaning lead-management.
- Researched limits: Adapt.io — Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; Kaspr — LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies.

Limitations — Adapt.io: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; No native email sequencing — data/export first; Kaspr: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; Native email outreach/sequencing depth is limited versus engagement platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Adapt.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches · Kaspr is a poor fit when that limitation bites: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies · Avoid Adapt.io if you actually need Kaspr's motion (LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
